Shares under public category include (a) 50 30 030 fully paid-up equity shares held in the Unclaimed Securities Suspense Escrow Account, (b) 75 656 fully paid-up equity shares held in the Unclaimed Suspense Account, (c) 16 001 fully paid-up equity shares held in Suspense Escrow Demat Account and (d) 3 47 51 258 fully paid-up equity shares held by Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority aggregating 3 98 72 945 shares on which voting rights are frozen. It also includes 3 50 92 619 fully paid-up equity shares held by the Trustees in JFSL TRUST - PHYS (RIL) for the benefit of shareholders of the Demerged Company holding shares in physical form on which the voting rights cannot be exercised till the time shares are credited to the demat account of concerned shareholders. 2. As per information furnished by the Promoter and Promoter Group, there are 48 members forming part of Promoter and Promoter Group of the Company, of which 2 promoter group entities do not hold any shares. 3. Relatives of Shri Mukesh D Ambani, Promoter of the Company are disclosed under the category 'Relatives of promoters' (other than immediate relatives of promoters disclosed under Promoter and Promoter Group category). 4. In accordance with the provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, the Company had, on September 3, 2025, allotted 50,00,00,000 warrants on a preferential basis, by way of private placement, to members of the promoter group. Out of the aforesaid, 25,00,00,000 warrants have been converted into 25,00,00,000 equity shares of face value of Rs.10 each on April 21, 2026.
